import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { toast } from 'react-toastify'; const Contact = () => { const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ name: '', email: '', subject: '', message: '', }); const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false); const handleChange = (e) => { setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value }); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!formData.name || !formData.email || !formData.message) { toast.error('Please fill in all required fields.'); return; } setSubmitted(true); toast.success('Thank you! Your message has been sent to the BatchBite team.'); setFormData({ name: '', email: '', subject: '', message: '' }); }; return (
Get In Touch

Contact & Support

Have questions about pre-orders, kitchen onboarding, or orders? We're here to assist.

{/* Contact Form */}

Send Us A Message

Message received! A team member will respond within 24 hours.
)}
{/* Contact Details & FAQs */}
Direct Channels
Support Email support@batchbite.com
Chef Onboarding Hotline +1 (800) 555-BITE
Headquarters Artisan Way, Portland, OR
Frequently Asked Questions

Each batch has an order deadline set by the chef (usually 24–48 hours before prep date) so ingredients can be sourced fresh. Once the deadline passes, ordering closes.

Yes! You can cancel orders in Pending or Confirmed status as long as the batch deadline has not passed. Your reserved items will be released back to the batch.

Register as a Business Owner, configure your kitchen profile, upload your products, and publish your first scheduled batch!
